auth_details: Server SDKs & GraphQL: public+private API keys via HTTP Basic (Base64 of PUBLIC_KEY:PRIVATE_KEY). Bearer only for tokenization keys, client-token auth fingerprints, or Braintree Auth OAuth access tokens (beta). Sandbox/prod use separate credentials and hosts.
example_request: curl -X POST https://payments.sandbox.braintree-api.com/graphql -H 'Authorization: Basic BASE64_ENCODED(PUBLIC_KEY:PRIVATE_KEY)' -H 'Braintree-Version: 2019-01-01' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"query": "query { ping }"}'
resolution_notes: auth.details: auditor correct. Official GraphQL guide documents merchant API keys as Authorization: Basic base64(PUBLIC_KEY:PRIVATE_KEY); Bearer is only for tokenization keys, client-token authorization fingerprints, or Braintree Auth OAuth (beta)—not generic GraphQL API keys. https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/graphql/guides/making_api_calls/ example.request: auditor correct. Official first-request ping curl uses Basic BASE64_ENCODED(PUBLIC_KEY:PRIVATE_KEY), not Bearer YOUR_API_KEY. Same URL plus transactions guide examples: https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/graphql/guides/transactions/
